mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_record (user_id, paper_id, test_title, test_type, subject_code, total_score, user_score, time_spent_seconds, status, start_time, submit_time, ai_report_summary, weak_points_json) VALUES (#{userId}, #{paperId}, #{testTitle}, #{testType}, #{subjectCode}, #{totalScore}, #{userScore}, #{timeSpentSeconds}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{submitTime}, #{aiReportSummary}, #{weakPointsJson})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, paper_id, test_title, test_type, subject_code, total_score, user_score, time_spent_seconds, status, start_time, submit_time, ai_report_summary, weak_points_json, created_at FROM test_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, user_id, paper_id, test_title, test_type, subject_code, total_score, user_score, time_spent_seconds, status, start_time, submit_time, ai_report_summary, weak_points_json, created_at FROM test_record ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
